tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rje phag mo gru pa'i zhus lan bzhugs//

༄༅// "$ dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// rtogs ldan rin po che la 'dud// rje rin po che sgam po pa la/ bla ma rin po che khams pas gal 'gag thams cad dril nas zhus pa/ bla ma rin po che lags/ rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa la gang gal che lags zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa nas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la dus gsum du mchod pa bas/ bla ma'i ba spu gcig la mchod pa phul ba bsod nams khyad par 'phags so// zhes pa dang*/ 'jam dpal las/ mchod 'os bstod 'os phyag gi gnas// rtag tu rim gro bya ba'i 'os// bkur 'os mchod par bya ba'i mchog /phyag byar 'os pa bla ma'i rab// ces pa dang*/ bla ma mi la'i zhal nas kyang*/ bla mas ji skad gsungs pa'i bka' bzhin bsgrubs nas/ bla ma la mos gus kyis gsol ba (2na)'debs shing*/ sgrub pa tshul bzhin du byed pa 'di kho na bsod nams che gsung*/ 'o na nyams su len pa la gdams ngag gang zab zhus pas/ jo bo rje'i brgyud pa'i lugs kyis/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa nas las rgyu 'bras dang*/ byams snying rje la blo nges na zab gsung*/ gang zag tshan cig gi zhal nas/ lta ba stong pa nyid du ma rtogs na mi phan gsung*/ la la'i zhal nas yi dam gyi lha bsgom pa zab zer te/ bla ma mi la'i zhal nas/ gtum mo srog rtsol bsgom pa zab gsungs pas/ so so rang re'i chos gang la nges shes skyes pa de zab/ 'o na yang bla ma la mos gus byas shing gtum mo dang phyag chen gnyis zung 'jug tu bsgoms nas byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyangs na/ rang don dang gzhan don gnyis ka dus mnyam du 'byung bas de zab gsung*/ 'o na sngon du gtum mo nas khrid pa dga' 'am phyag (2ba) rgya chen po nas khrid pa dga' zhus pas/ de gnyis gang zag gi rigs kyis 'byed de/ na so gzhon pa rtsa dang khams bzang ba la gtum mo rang nas khrid cing bsgoms pas drod rtags myur du 'ong*/

de la phyag rgya chen po btab pas nyams rtogs myur du 'char gsung*/ na so rgas pas rlung mi chun pa'i rigs tshan cig la phyag rgya chen po'am lhan cig skyes sbyor btab pa dga' ste/ dang po nas phyag rgya chen po btab pas rang rgyud la ma skyes par las la ngan du song nas dred pa yang 'ong gsung*/ 'o na gang zag cig car ba dang rim gyis pa gnyis la khyad ci bdog zhus pas/ de gnyis la sbyangs pa che chung zhig gi khyad yin te/ cig car ba'i rigs ni sngon gyi sbyangs pa che ba'i stobs kyis/ gdams ngag btab pa tsam gyis brtan pa rtogs pa dus mnyam du 'char te/ ngo bo rgyun chad med par gnas pa/ bla ma la mos gus che ba/ sems can la snying rje che ba/ bdag tu 'dzin pa'i zhen pa med pa zhig 'ong ba yin pas/ de la bogs 'don tsam mi dgos/ de rgyud la skyes pa de rang skyong ba las med gsung*/ rim gyis pa ni sbyangs pa chung bas nyams myong yang rim gyis las mi skye bas/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ mos gus yengs pa med par bsgom pa gal che/ rab 'dir/ 'bring 'chi ka'am bar do tshun chad la ngo bo rtogs pa'i ye shes 'char gsung*/ de yang zhi gnas tshan can las 'char te/ skad cig ma gsal ba'i lhag mthong las 'char ba yin gsung*/ 'o na rtogs pa skyes nas bsgom 'tshal lam mi 'tshal zhus pas/ sgom med (3na)kyi rtogs pa skyes nas sems dran pas 'dzin pa'i cha nas bsgom mi dgos te/ sangs rgyas nas sems can du ldog mi srid/ bsgom rgyu med de rtogs pa'i chos nyid de rang la goms shing blo sbyangs pas mngon par shes pa drug dang*/ spyan lnga dang ye shes lnga dang*/ phyi lus kyi bkod pa dang rdzu 'phrul dang*/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i yon tan yar ldan du rtogs pa'i 'bras bur 'char dgos te/ de yang chos nyid kyi rtsal sbyangs pas shes pa la rang dbang thob pa zhig 'ong*/ de la shes bya'i cha thams cad 'phral la dwangs sing 'char ba la thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan zer ba yin/

bya rgyu med zer nas rtog pa rang yan du bzhag pas phan gnod kyi 'bras bu 'byin mi nus pas thams cad mkhyen pa mi 'byung gsung*/ 'o na ngo bo gang gis rnyed pa lags zhus pas/ bla ma'i byin rlabs dang*/ rang gi mos gus dang*/ brtson 'grus kyis bsgom pa'i stobs las rnyed kyi/ de las gzhan du mi rnyed de/ de yang dgyes pa rdo rje las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang*// rang gis bsod nams las shes bya// zhes so// 'di mkhas pa paṇḍi tas kyang mi shes/ shes rab kyis mi rtogs/ rtog ge ba'i spyod yul ma yin/ don rgyud la skye ba la bla ma rtogs ldan zhig la slob mas mos gus byas pas byin rlabs kyi stobs kyis tshig dang bral ba blo'i yul las 'das pa rang las 'char te/ ngo bo 'phags pa klu sgrub la sogs pa mkhas pa rnams kyang khas len dang bral ba yin te/ (3ba) dgyes pa rdo rje las/ sgom pa po med bsgom bya med// lha med sngags kyang yod ma yin// bsgom par bya ba cung zad med// spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin la// lha dang sngags ni yang dag gnas// zhes pa dang*/ 'jam dpal las kyang*/ dus gsum dus med rtogs pa po// sems can kun gyi don kun rig /ces gsungs pas/ de skyes pa'i dus na/ dkar po chig thub gcig shes kun grol du song bas/ sangs rgyas rang la rnyed/ des 'khor bar 'dzin pa'i sgrog rang brdal du 'gro bas rang sems bde ba chen po'i sa non bya ba yin gsung*/ 'o na phyag rgya chen po dang lhan cig skyes sbyor gnyis la khyad bdog gam mi bdog zhus pas/ phyag rgya chen po ni 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad ye nas lhun gyis grub pa/ chos nyid nam mkha' lta bu dus thams cad pa'i ye shes/ gnyis med cig yin te rgyun chad pa med pa yin/ lhan cig skyes sbyor ni rtog pa gang skyes sku bzhir sbyor ba yin pas dus thams cad par mi 'dod de rgyun chad yod gsung*/

'o na nyams dang rtogs pa gnyis la khyad ci tsam bdog zhus pas/ nyams ni blo'i cha las ma 'das pa yin te/ dper na sprin gseb kyi nyi ma dang 'dra/ bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum/ res mtho res dma' ba gnas pa 'ong ba yin pas/ 'di la ma zhen par bskyangs pas blo'i dri ma dwangs nas rtogs pa gdod 'char gsung*/ rtogs pa ni snang sems gnyis med du blo yi steng nas rtogs pa/ 'od gsal ngang nas rgyun chad med pas bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba'i dus su rtogs thob dus mnyam du 'char ba la zer ba yin gsung*/ 'o na mthong lam dang khyad ci mchis zhus pas/ mthong lam dang bstun du yod pa ma yin te/ sems kyi ngo bo bag tsam mthong ba ni/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam yin/ de bas kyang phyag rgya chen po bag tsam zhig mthong ba ni 'phags pa (4na)dgra bcom pa'i mthong lam yin/ chos nyid nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil lta bur mthong ba ni byang chub sems dpa'i mthong lam yin/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid du mthong ba ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mthong lam yin/ de yang shes rab snying po nas/ gzugs stong pa'o// stong pa nyid kyang gzugs so// zhes so// rnal 'byor pa'i dbang du byas na/ sems kyi ngo bo bag tsam zhig mthong ba ni rnal 'byor pa tha ma'i mthong lam yin/ ngo bo spros bral tsam du mthong ba ni rnal 'byor pa 'bring gi mthong lam yin/ sems kyi ngo bo skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bar mthong nas de la rgyun chad med pa de/ rnal 'byor pa rab kyi mthong lam yin/ 'o na snang ba 'di la sems can dang 'phags pa dang rnal 'byor pa dang sangs rgyas la khyad ci tsam mchis zhus pas/ sems can gyi dus na dngos 'dzin gyi snang ba bya ba yin/ 'phags pa la sgyu ma'i snang ba bya ba yin/ rnal 'byor pa la nyams kyi snang ba bya ba yin/ sangs rgyas la 'od gsal gyi snang ba'am/

zung 'jug gi snang ba bya ba yin gsung*/ 'o na sgyu lus dang 'od gsal dang zung 'jug dang phyag rgya chen po la khyad ci mchis zhus pas/ sgyu lus la ma dag pa'i sgyu lus tha mal du 'dzin pa yin/ dag pa'i sgyu lus sangs rgyas kyi sku yi snang ba yin/ 'od gsal la yang slob pa'i 'od gsal ting nge 'dzin gyi cha yin te/ rnal 'byor pa'i dus yin/ mi slob pa'i 'od gsal ni sangs rgyas kyi dus la zer ba yin/ zung 'jug kyang bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ slob pa'i zung 'jug ni/ rnal (4ba)'byor pa'i zung 'jug lam la gnas pa yin/ mi slob pa'i zung 'jug ni chos kyi sku dang gzugs sku gnyis dbyer med pa sangs rgyas kyi dus la zer ba yin/ phyag rgya chen po la yang lam la gnas pa'i dus na/ lam phyag rgya chen po zer ba yin/ 'khor 'das gnyis su med pa'i ye shes chen por rtogs nas blang dor dang bral ba'i dus/ mthar thug gi phyag rgya chen po bya ba yin/ de dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa de yin pas/ sangs rgyas logs nas btsal du mi rnyed de/ de gong ma'i dus su gnas na lam gyi rnal 'byor la gnas pa yin/ 'og ma'i dus su gnas na sangs rgyas zin byang chub zin/ de las lhag pa'am gong na sangs rgyas pa cig med pas na bde bar gshegs pa zer ba yin gsung*/ 'o na gzhan don byed pa'i dus nam lags zhus pas/ ro gcig chen po'i rtogs pa rgyud la skyes nas slob ma 'khrid du nyan pa yin te/ 'on kyang sgom med kyi rtogs pa gsha' ma de ma skyes par/ mngon shes mi 'ong*/ mngon par shes pa de med par/ gzhan gyi blo tshod mtho dma' dus la bab ma bab mi shes/ sgom med kyi rtogs pa skyes na/ snying rje chen pos gzhan don la blo 'gro ba dang*/ rang tshe 'di nyid las blo ldog pa dang*/ tshe 'di'i ltos thag rbad chod nas thugs rje chen po rgyun chad med par shar ba'i dus na gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba yin gsung ngo*// 'o na bla ma rin po che'i thugs la 'khrungs pa 'di gtum mo bsgoms pa las byung ba lags sam/

phyag rgya chen po bsgoms pa las byung ba lags zhus pas/ nga'i yon tan rgyud la skyes pa 'di gdams ngag bsgoms pa yang yin/ de bas kyang bla ma mi la ci (5na)gsung bka' bzhin bsgrubs shing mos gus byas pa'i byin rlabs kyis byung ba yin/ bla ma nā ro pas kyang bla ma'i bka' bzhin du mdzad pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub dus gcig tu thob pa yin gsung*/ 'o na sngon bas da lta ngo bo rgyud la skye ba sla bar gda' bas rgyu ci lags zhus pas/ de sngon la skyes pa'i rna ba bas/ phyi nas skyes pa'i rwa ring ba yin pas bla ma'i byin rlabs dang rtogs pa mthor song*/ slob ma mos gus cher song ba'i stobs kyis rgyud la skye sla ba yin gsung*/ jo bo khams pa ston pa khyod 'dra ba'i chos dri mkhas pa ma byung gsung*/ 'di na yang rtogs pa mtho ba dang dge sbyor bzang ba mang du yod de gsung ngo*// sgam po zangs lung yang dgon du// rje rin po che snyi ba chen po la// mdo 'gag rin chen 'phreng ba 'di// zhus pas 'gro rnams ma lus pa// gnyis med ye shes rgyas par shog /tshe 'dir 'ja' lus chos sku thob pa la// tshe 'di'i zang zing ltos thag rab spangs shing*// dben pa'i gnas su bla ma yi dam brten tshul gyis// rlung sems gnyis med phyag rgya che la sbyar bar bya// dpe dang tha snyad mang pos 'di la dgos pa med// ༈ bla ma rin po che la na mo// bla ma ratna bdag gis 'khor 'das gnyis rtsad gcod cing*/ chos nyid ngo sprod pa cig zhu byas pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas 'o cag 'khor 'das gnyis zer ba dang*/ sangs rgyas dang sems can gnyis zer ba ste/ de don ci yin na/ sems la rig pa dang ma rig pa gnyis/ rig pa ngo shes ma shes gnyis su 'dug /rig pa ngo shes na sangs rgyas zer ba yin pas rig pa chos nyid du ngo sprod par bya (5ba) ste/ ri khrod la sogs skyo ba skye zhing nyams 'phel ba yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su phyin la/

sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed la/ lus lhar bsgom/ bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ rang gi sems rnam rtog gang gis kyang ma bslad pa/ ci yang ma yin pas sems gang yang ma bcos pa/ gsal sing nge ye re sal le hrig ge bzhag /de ltar bzhag pas la la na re/ bsgom pa'i dus su gsal sing nge ba zhig 'dug ste/ de sgom yin nam min zer ba 'byung ste/ de kho na rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor bya ba yin te/ de la brtson 'grus bskyed nas bsgoms pas dang por sems 'phro ba tsug 'dug kyang*/ rtog pa'i bag chags je chung du 'gro ba yin/ rtog pa chung du song bas sems nyid je dwangs je dwangs la 'gro ba yin/ des sgrib pa thams cad 'dzad pa yin/ dus de tsam na bya ba thams cad btang la bla ma dang*/ yi dam la sogs pa la gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ mos gus drag po byed pa dang*/ bya ba btang nas bsgom pa la brtson pa skom pa chu 'thung ba 'dra ba cig dgos pa yin no// dus de tsam na nga la sgom mi 'ong snyam pa kun la yang*/ nan tan byas pas 'ong gin 'dug /dang po nas btang snyoms su lteng sing nge ba des bag mi yong bar 'dug /de ltar gsal sing nge ba bsgoms pas sdig pa zad nas rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor gsha' ma zhig nang nas rgyud la skye ste/ shes pa rten med pa gang la yang ma reg par/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba rig pa'i ngo bo shun pa bshus pa 'dra ba'am/ ngo bo la snying po bcug pa lta bu cig 'ong ste/ de tsam na ma rnyed pa rnyed ngo ma shes pa (6na)shes/ dbul po'i lag tu gter rnyed pa lta bur zag pa med pa'i dga' ba rgyas pa 'ong ste/ sems spro sing nge dga' sing nge ba zhig yong ba yin no// de la nan tan bskyed nas bsgoms pas 'khrul pa'i rtog pa rnams sangs/ rtsol sgrub kyi nyams len dang bral nas/ rig pa spros med du song bas spros bral gyi rnal 'byor zhes bya ste/

snang ba la blo btang yang mi 'gro bar snang ba dgag sgrub dang bral ba ste/ snang ba thams cad lung ma bstan du 'gro ba yin no// de la bsgoms pas yun ring du gnas pas du ma ro gcig gi rnal 'byor zhes bya ba nang nas 'char te/ rnam rtog gi snang ba la rig pas sgro 'dogs gcod mi dgos par/ thams cad sems su thag chod pa zhig 'ong ba yin no// de tsam na rang rkya thub pa zhig 'ong ba yin/ de yang blo yar ldan du 'ong ste/ snang ba 'di sems kyi rnam 'phrul yin par shes pa zhig skye ste/ bsgom mi dgos par snang ba 'di res sgyu mar mthong*/ res stong par mthong*/ res rtog pa 'phro ba tsug byed/ rig pa dang stong pa ngo sprad pa'i gnad kas ngo bo la blo lhan gyis bzhag tsa na/ rtog pa thams cad gar song cha med la 'gro ba yin/ de la yun ring du sing nge gnas pas bsgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba skye ste/ snang ba thams cad chos nyid 'od gsal du 'char ro// 'dod chags la sogs pa nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog skyes pa dang*/ chos nyid 'od gsal du lhag gis shar ba dang gnyis dus gcig tu lhang lhang shar ba yin no// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ snang ba dang rtog pa chos nyid rang yin pa'i phyir ro// rig pa dang chos sku rdo rus phrad pa'i gnad kas/ bsgom mi dgos (6ba) par chos skur lhang lhang 'char ro// de tsam na mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob med pa yin te/ bsgoms kyang 'ong la ma sgom yang 'ong ba'o// 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug ci byas kyang chos nyid 'od gsal rgyun chad med par gnas so// de'i dus rig stong gi ngo bo la nges pa'i shes pas nang du bltas pa'i dus su/ ngo bo'i don de la gang gis kyang ma phog pa yin/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i smra bsam brjod med kyis kyang ma phog /dbu ma pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis skye ma myong byas pas kyang ma phog /ma hā mu dras blo las 'das pa yin byas pas kyang ma phog

/sems tsam pa'i lta ba rang rig rang gsal yin byas pas kyang ma phog /nga'i tshig gis brjod pa de rnams kyis kyang ye mi phog /de nges pa'i shes pa kha phyir bltas pa'i dus su tshig tsam du mtshon na de rnams gang dang yang mi 'gal ba yin/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rig pa dang snang ba bkag pas mi khegs/ de nyid kyi don stong pa nyid de bsgrub pas mi 'grub/ de tsam na tshig dang tha snyad rtog pa'i spyod yul min/ phyogs re nas mtshon na gang dang yang mthun/ de'i dus su mnyam bzhag chen po'i rnal 'byor zhes kyang bya'o/ /bla ma rin po che'i thugs nyams las 'khrungs pa'i chos yin/ nyams skyes pa rnams la ngo sprod par byed pa/ the tshom za bar byed pa rnams kyi zhu gtugs byed pa dang*/ gegs sel bar byed pa dang*/ ngo bo rnal ma skyes pa rnams kyi nyams dang sre bar byed pa rdzogs so// //bla ma rin po che sgam pa po la rje rin po che phag mo gru pas zhus lan gyi tshul du zhus pa'o// ༈ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma rin po che la kho bos phyis chos zhig zhus pa ni/ rig pa (7na)shes pa'i sgo nas chos thams cad kyi spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid gtan la phab ste/ rtog pa bzang po skyes kyang rtog pa'i phreng bar gda'/ thabs lam zab mo bsgoms kyang rnam rtog nyid la nyid bkal du 'dug ste/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams bzang po skyes kyang*/ bla ma byin rlabs can dang*/ gsang sngags kyi thabs lam zab mo khyad par can dang*/ rang gi mos gus dang*/ dka' thub 'dzom pa'i dus bzang por song ba tsug 'dug kyang*/ skyes bu chang gis bzi ba'i dus na bsam brjod bral ba'i nyams skyes pa'am/ gzhon nus bde ba myong ba'i dus su smra bsam brjod med kyi nyams skyes pa'am/ bde ba thob pa dang 'dra bar/ zhe sdang drag po la sogs pa rkyen drag po skyes pa'i stobs kyis rkyen mi bzlog pa'i dus su rnal 'byor pa grong du 'khyams pas/

'dod yon gyi mgo 'khor ba'i dus su nyams bzang po thams cad kyang*/ bzi sangs pa bzhin du 'gro bar 'dug pas de tsam na chos kyi don la nges pa'i shes pa ma skyes na/ cis kyang mi phan par gda' bas/ rnal 'byor rnam pa bzhi'i rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor gsha' ma zhig skyes dus su/ nges pa'i shes pa ci 'dra ba zhig skye ba lags/ de nas spros bral gyi rnal 'byor ma nor ba zhig skyes pa'i dus su nges shes ci 'dra ba zhig skye ba lags/ de nas du ma ro gcig gi rnal 'byor ma nor ba zhig skyes pa'i dus su nges pa'i shes pa ci 'dra ba zhig skye ba lags/ de nas bsgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor ma nor ba zhig skyes pa'i dus su nges pa'i shes pa ci 'dra ba zhig skye ba lags zhes zhus pas/ zhal (7ba) 'dzum mdzad nas/ 'o dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis chos go bar 'dug gsung nas/ ngas ni bla ma dam pa'i drin gyis bla ma'i yon tan ba spu nyag ma brgyar gshags pa tsam zhig dgos te/ nges pa'i shes pa bag tsam zhig skyes pa de/ 'gro ba la phan pa'i bsam pas ngo bo rjen par bshad nas/ rig pa dang stong pa ngo sprad kyang*/ ston pa kun dang sgom chen mang po byon pa rnams/ nges pa'i shes pa mi skye bar/ lo ma dang yal ga 'dra ba'i tshig na ya mang po dang*/ thabs lam zhu zer ba mang po 'ong bar 'dug /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis go bar 'dug pas 'di ltar yin pa la/ thugs la zung zhig gsungs nas gnang ba ni/ de la dang po rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor ma nor ba zhig skyes pa'i dus/ rang gi rig pa 'di rnam rtog gis ma bskyod par cir yang ma bcos gang la yang mi sems par bzhag pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po yin pas nges pa'i shes pa skye dgos/ kha cig de ltar skyes kyang*/ yin par ma shes pas/ sgom de dmigs gtad can nam/ nyams myong can nam/ yang na rnam rtog 'gags snang ba nub nas ro bzhin du 'gro bar 'dug ste/

de min gsung*/ de nas spros bral gyi rnal 'byor ma nor ba zhig skyes pa'i dus su/ gsal stong la blo 'byongs pas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang sems kyi rnam 'phrul yin te/ sems nyid skye ba med pa rtsad chod nas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang sar dag pa'i nges pa'i shes pa lhangs kyis skye dgos/ de ltar mkha' 'gro ma gur las/ sems bsgoms pas ni sangs rgyas te// rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// (8na)sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// ces so// de nas du ma ro gcig gi rnal 'byor ma nor ba zhig skyes pa'i dus su/ sems kyi snang ba rig pa'i rtsal rnam rtog sna tshogs su 'gyus kyang gnyen po gzhan brten mi dgos par sems kyi rnam rtog nyid la bden pa dang rtag par ma grub par ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes te/ chos nyid du nges pa'i shes pa lhangs kyis skye dgos/ de nas tha ma bsgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor ma nor ba zhig skyes pa'i dus su/ sems kyi rnam rtog dang bsgoms pa'i nyams dang rtogs pa'i shes rab rnams ngo bo mthong ba'i mthus dbyings su yal te/ tha mal gyi shes pa ma bcos pa chos nyid du ngos 'dzin pa nges pa'i shes pa lhangs kyis skye dgos/ de yang dang por rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i dus su/ bya ba thams cad blos btang la lus sems khong glod la sems nam mkha' ltar 'phangs bstod/ sa gzhi ltar rgya bskyed/ ri bo ltar lhun dbab/ mar me ltar gsal gdon/ man shel ltar dri ma spangs te/ gsal stong rtog pa dang bral ba'i sing nge ye re bzhag /de'i dus su khams dang 'byung ba'i stobs kyis res gsal sing nge ba'i nyams skye/ res stong sang nge ba skye/ res rtog pa 'phro/ res rtog ge ba yang yod/ res nga la sgom med snyam pa'i yi mug pa'ang 'ong*/ ji ltar gyur yang sems nyid gsal stong du ma bcos par sing nge ba kho na la nan tan du bsgom mo// de ci zhig tsa na rtse gcig rnal 'byor gsha' ma de nam skyes cha med par 'char te/

de la nyams ni shes pa spro sing nge dga' sing nge ba/ snang ba la spros pa btang yang mi (8ba) 'gro bar gsal sing nge gnas pa zhig 'byung ngo*// de'i dus su nges pa'i shes pa zhig skye ste/ chu ma rnyogs par bzhag pa lta bu'am/ me tog bzhin du dwangs sing nge sal le 'byung ste/ rig pa ma bcos par chos nyid du ngo 'phrod pas re dogs thams cad dang bral lo// de nyid spros bral gyi rnal 'byor yin te/ de la bsgoms pas nyams ni spros pa'i mtha' thams cad rig pa rang gi cho 'phrul yin pas/ rig pa gsal stong du dag tsa na/ rig pa lhang nge lhan ne rjen ne ce re ba zhig 'byung*/ de'i dus su nges pa'i shes pa zhig skye ste/ skyu ru ra rlon pa lag mthil du bzhag pa'am/ man shel phyis nas dag pa mkhar gzhong du bzhag pa bzhin/ spros pa'i mtha' thams cad rig pa'i rnam 'phrul yin te/ rig pa ngo shes pas gsal dwangs su dag tsa na/ rig stong gsal dwangs su lhag ge ba zhig 'byung ngo*// de la yun ring du bsgoms pas du ma ro gcig gi rnal 'byor bya ba 'char te/ de la nyams shig 'char ba ni bsgom pa'i blo btang mi dgos par ngo bo rang gsal du hrig ge gnas/ gnyen po brten mi dgos par rtog pa mi 'byung*/ sgro 'dogs bcad mi dgos par sems gsal stong du dag pas/ rtog dpyod kyi blo mi 'char ro// de'i dus su nges pa'i shes pa zhig skye ste/ nyi ma shar tsa na mun pa rang sar dag pa bzhin du/ rig pa gsal stong du dag tsa na/ rnam rtog btsal yang mi rnyed par dag sing nge 'gro ba'o// de'i dus shes pa kha nang du bltas pas/ ngo bo gsal dag chos nyid kyi bde bar gsal sing nge ba de mnyam bzhag yin la/ shes pa phyir bltas pas snang ba lung ma bstan du lta ba de rjes thob yin/ (9na)lar mnyam rjes med pa yin/ de'i dus bsgom du med pa'i sgom pa/ bsam du med pa'i bsam gtan/ chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor zhes bya'o// de yang yun ring du bsgoms pas bsgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor zhes pa skye ste/

de la nyams ni ston ka'i nyi ma gung gi nam mkha'i dkyil bzhin du/ cir yang ma grub/ gar yang ma 'gags pa/ ci la yang mi gnas gang dang yang mthun/ 'du 'bral med par sing nge gnas pa'o// de'i dus su nges pa'i shes pa zhig skye ste/ tha mal pa'i shes pa ma bcos pa 'di grwa ma chag zur ma nyams/ rgya ma zhig pa/ zhi cham cham/ bde mal mal/ ma bcos ma bslad pa/ ma bsnan ma bri bar chos nyid du lhangs kyis shar ba'o// de'i dus su snang ba dang rig pa bkag pas mi khegs pa ste/ sems nyid kyi rtsal du rang snang rang shar ba'i gnad kas so// rtog pa dang 'khrul pa btsal kyang mi rnyed de/ de nyid kyi ngo bo rang stong rang dag pa'i gnad kas so// chos nyid bsgrubs pas mi 'grub ste/ bsgom du med cing rang bzhin skye ma myong ba'i gnad kas so// gnas pa la bzhag pa'i thabs med de/ bsgoms tshad 'khrul pa yin pa'i gnad kas so// yang na stong nyid ngo bo bsgom du mi btub pa'i gnad ka'o// mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob med de chos nyid de spang thob dang bral ba'i phyir ro// de ltar yang he badzra las/ gzugs med mthong ba po yang med// sgra med thos pa po yang med// dri med snom pa po yang med// ro med myong ba po yang med// reg med reg pa po yang med// sems med sems las byung ba med// (9ba) ces pas so// yang he badzra las/ sems can sangs rgyas yin mod kyang*// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// dri ma de bsal sangs rgyas nyid// ces so// gang zhig yid kyis ma bsgoms par// 'gro ba thams cad bsgom par bya// zhes so// lar dang po rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor gyi dus su/ 'du 'dzi spangs shing brtson 'grus bskyed pa gal che/ de nas spros bral gyi rnal 'byor gyi dus su btang snyoms la ma lus par shes pa ngar dang bcas pa gal che/ du ma ro gcig gi rnal 'byor gyi dus su go yul spyi'i rnam pa dang ma 'dres par nang du nyams su myong ba gal che/

bsgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dus su nyams myong gi rtsi la ma 'byar ba gal che gsung ngo*// nyams la ma zhen pa zhig dgos gsung*/ bla ma rin po che'i thugs las 'khrungs pa'i rnal 'byor chos bzhi phra rgyas dang bcas pa kho bos zhus lan gyi tshul du zhus pa'o// ༈ //na mo ratna gu ru/ mnyam med rin po che la 'dud/ dang po zhi gnas skye bar byed pa'i rgyu bzhi/ bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis skye ba dang*/ rten 'brel las skye ba dang*/ tshogs bsags pa las skye ba dang*/ sdig pa sbyangs pa las skye ba dang bzhi'o// sems kyi ngo bo ma bcos pa ma bslad pa rnal ma gsal la dag pa dus thams cad pa rgyun chad med pa zhig yin te/ de la yang gnyis/ snang la nges pa dang snang la ma nges pa'o// ston ka'i nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ sems gnyis su med par rtogs pa de snang la nges pa yin/ yar sangs rgyas la mi re/ mar 'khor ba la mi dogs/ gzhan gyis bsgyur yang mi 'gyur ba de snang la ma (10na)nges pa yin no/ ma nges pa'i nyams myong la bzhi ste/ zhi gnas kyi bde gsal mi rtog pa'o// nyams la res yod snyam la res med dam snyam mo// mi rtog pas rgyu byas nas mar ldog nyen yod/ khams gsum du 'khor ba'i rgyur yang 'gro nyen yod/ dang po slob pa'i dus su rig pa gsal sing nge de la slob/ de yang shes pa ma yengs pa la slob/ de yang rig pa'i ngo bo ma yengs pa la slob par bya'o// de la goms tsa na rang la nges shes skye ba yin gsung*/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo de ma shor bar byas nas/ rnam rtog ste ci tsam yang 'pho ba yin gsung*/ dper na nam mkha' rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa yin yang*/ sprin dang na bun dang khug sna la sogs pa ci tsam yang 'ong ba yin gsung*/ nam mkha' rang la dengs nas 'gro ba dang 'dra'o// de yang rnam rtog grogs su 'gro ba bya ba yin/ rnam rtog 'phro ru ma btub na slar la thu ba yin gsung*/

gzugs med du skye nyen yod gsung*/ yi dam skad cig gis rdzogs par bsgom dgos gsung*/ skad cig dran rdzogs kyis 'od gsal 'ba' zhig bsgom pa'o// de yang gsal sing nge ba de nyams myong yin/ de la ma yengs pa de gnas pa yin/ shes rab kyis bltas pas ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa de rtogs pa yin/ bla ma rtogs ldan gyis slob ma skal ldan tshe 'di nyid blos btang ba zhig dang phrad na/ bla ma des ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i dbang bzhi bskur nas/ smin pa grol bar byed pa'i lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis la slob pa yin gsung*/ bskyed rim ni lha'i sku sgyu ma ltar bsgom pa dang*/ rtsa rlung dang spros pa dang bcas (10ba) pa'i rdzogs rim yang de yin gsung*/ rdzogs rim ni 'od gsal stong nyid mngon sum du gzigs pa de'o// de ltar bskyed rdzogs gnyis bsgoms pas yon tan 'byung ste/ de yang dben par bsgoms pa las 'byung ngo*// lus sems bde ba 'ong ste/ nang du rtags lnga 'char/ phyir yang yon tan brgyad 'byung ste/ nang na rtags dang yon tan du ba lta bu byung tsa na rlung gi snang ba 'gags te rlung dhū tir tshud pa yin gsung*/ rtags gnyis pa shar tsam na snang ba thams cad nyams su myong ba 'di lta bu 'byung*/ snang grags kyi chos sun dbyung ba grogs po mdza' bos bslus pa lta bu 'byung*/ 'jig rten pa'i bde ba la yid mi rtog pa mkhas pas 'ja' tshon mthong ba lta bu 'byung*/ cir snang ba thams cad chos nyid du snang bas/ gser gling nas ra gan btsal kyang mi rnyed pa lta bu 'byung*/ snang grags thams cad nyams la thim pas/ lan tshwa chu la thim pa lta bu'i nyams 'byung*/ zab mo'i chos la dungs dungs byed pa bu dang pha ring du ma phrad pa lta bu 'byung*/ rang gis shes pa ngo mtshar skyes nas dbul pos gter rnyed pa lta bu 'byung*/ zab mo'i chos ma lus pa ji bzhin shes pa ka li ka'i phrug gu lta bu 'byung*/

ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje chen po lhag par skye ba/ 'dod chags can gyis bud med gzugs mdzes pa mthong ba lta bu 'byung*/ de'i yon tan nyams su blangs shing bsgoms pa dang*/ mchog gi rnal 'byor pa zhes chos kyi sku bde ba chen po mngon du 'gyur ro// de nas sems can gyi don du gzugs sku gnyis 'byung bar 'gyur ro// gnyug ma'i (11na)snying po 'byung ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //na mo gu ru/ sems nyid 'gyur ba med pa/ rgyun chad med pa/ dus thams cad pa zhes bya ste/ 'gyur ba med pa ni dbyibs dang kha dog tu ma grub pas 'gyur ba med pa'o// rgyun chad med pa ni rig pa rgyun chad med pa'o// dus thams cad pa ni dus 'di nas yod 'di nas med bya ba med de/ ma skyes shing mi 'gags pa'i phyir dus thams cad pa'o// sems can grub mthas blo ma 'gyur ba rnams la rtog pa/ grub mthas blo bsgyur ba rnams la rig pas rtogs pa'i dus su ye shes so// rang rig gzhan rig gnyis ni/ rang rig ni rang gi rang ngo shes pa'o// gzhan rig ni snang ba sna tshogs dkar dmar du snang ba thams cad gzhan nas ma byung ste/ rang gi sems su shes pa'o// yang rtogs na ye shes ma rtogs na mo ha/ go na rang sems/ ma go na gdong thob/ byed na 'bad rtsol/ mi byed na shugs 'byung*/ 'dod na sgrub dgos/ mi 'dod na re dogs med pa 'bras bu'i mchog go/ //gu ru na mo/ bla ma rin po che la/ phyag rgya chen po'i gzhung rnams kyis/ chos nyid dang sems nyid gang gtan la 'bebs pa legs zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ do ha dang*/ gsar ma skor gsum la sogs pa'i phyag rgya chen po ston pa'i gzhung 'di tsho/ chos bshad pa'i bshad pa po rnams kyis kyang*/ ngo bo rtogs pas ngo bo'i thog tu bshad/ gzhi rtogs pas gzhi thog tu bshad/ ngo bo rtogs pas ngo bo'i thog tu go /gzhi rtogs pas gzhi (11ba) thog tu go

/don la sems nyid kyi ngo bo stong pa yin pa la/ gang zag gi blo yi dbang gis so sor go ba yin gsung*/ snang sems gnyis gcig gam tha dad zhus pas/ snang sems gnyis gcig yin/ sems las ma gtogs pa'i snang ba logs na med gsung*/ snang ba ni sems kyi 'od dam sems kyi chos nyid yin pas/ sems rtogs pa'i dus su snang ba sgrog rang brdal du 'gro gsung*/ sems nyid dang chos nyid gcig gam tha dad zhus pas/ sems nyid dang chos nyid gnyis gcig yin te/ sems kyi 'od chos nyid yin pas/ sems nyid rtogs pas chos nyid sgrog rang brdal du 'gro ste/ dper na nyi ma song nas 'od phyir chad pa mi srid de/ nyi ma'i phyir 'od 'gro bas 'gro ldog nges pa yin/ de bzhin du sems nyid gcig po rtogs pas chos nyid rang shugs la rtogs te 'ong*/ sems dag pas snang ba rang shugs la dag /des na snang ba dang sems nyid la sogs pa rang sor bzhag la/ sems kyi ngo bo 'ba' zhig bsgoms pas chog gsung*/ snang ba dang chos nyid yul dang yul can bor nas/ sems nyid ngo bo'i thog tu bsgom lags sam zhus pas/ bsgom pa'i dus su chos dang chos nyid blos bzhag nas/ sems ngo bo'i thog tu yer gyis rgan mo mdzub tshug tu bsgom gsung*/ yang na phyi nang snod bcud thams cad sems nyid du gtan la wal ba cig phab nas de nas de'i thog tu bsgom/ de gnyis 'dra/ chos nyid gzhi'i thog tu bsgoms nas ngo bo ma rnyed par bsgoms kyang sangs mi rgya gsung*/ rlung sems gnyis gcig gam tha dad (12na)zhus pas/ rlung sems gnyis gcig yin/ rlung gis g.yos pas sems kyi rnam rtog sna tshogs su 'char ba yin/ de gnyis de dang gzhan du brjod du med par gnas te/ sems rtogs pa'i dus su rlung rang sar dag nas 'gro /gnyis med rig stong lhan cig skyes pa yin gsung*/ 'khor ba la thog mtha' yod dam med zhus pas/ thog mtha' med cing gting mtha' med de/

khams gsum spyi btsan dang gang zag dgos btsan gnyis ka la 'khor ba'i nang du ma 'khrul bya ba 'di yin med/ 'on kyang gang zag dgos btsan la lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ngos zin cing rtogs nas sangs rgyas pa'i tshe na/ mtha' ni yod/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ngos ma zin bar du/ 'khor ba la thog mtha' med pa yin pa la/ lhan cig skyes pa de gnas pa ni 'khor 'das gnyis ka la khyad med par gnas pa yin pas/ de ngos zin ma zin gyi khyad las med/ sangs rgyas dang sems can la khyad par gang yang med gsung*/ 'o na bsgom pa'i dus su lus kyi spyod lam ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ spyod lam 'di ltar yin bya ba med de/ gang bder bsgom pa yin/ spyod lam rnam bzhi gang byed kyang*/ mnyam bzhag rjes thob med par chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du bsgom gsung*/ 'o na gnyid kyi bar du rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du 'gro'am zhus pas/ gnyid chu bo rgyun gyi bar chad du mi 'gro ste/ he badzra las/ gnyid ni spang bar mi bya'o// zhes gsungs pa yin mod/ gnyid rtog med 'od gsal chos sku yin la/ gnyid mthug po'i dus su gsal cha (12ba) med pa tsam las/ gzhan rnam rtog med pa gnyid chos sku yin/ lhan cig skyes pa med pa ma yin te/ mi rtog pa de ka chos sku yin/ gnyid srab pa'i dus su rmi lam sna tshogs rmi ba de/ sgyu ma lta bu'i gzugs sku rnam gnyis yin/ gnyid ma log tsa na bsgom pa'i dus dang gnyid kyi dus su 'od gsal khyad med pa'ang 'ong*/ de lta bu byung na gnyid ma log pa dang khyad ci yod des na gnyid kyis bar chad du 'gro ba min gsung*/ sngon du tshad med pa bzhi bsgom 'tshal zhus pas/ ngo bo skyes pa'i nyams de rgyun ma chad par gnas pa la/ tshad med pa bsgom mi dgos te/ stong nyid btang snyoms chen po bya ba yin pas/ yon tan yar ldan yin gsung ngo*// ngo bo rtogs pa'i dus na zag bcas kyi sdom pa 'tshal lam mi 'tshal zhus pas/

bslab pa gsum mam sdom pa gsum logs su mi dgos/ zag med kyi gshis la yar ldan du tshang ba yin gsung*/ stong nyid snying rje can du bsgom 'tshal lam mi 'tshal zhus pas/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje yar ldan du yod pas/ chos la dmigs pa dang sems can la dmigs pa gnyis logs su mi dgos te/ de gnyis kyi don tshang ba dang de gnyis bsgom pa'i yul mi dmigs pas/ bsgom du med gsung*/ byang chub kyi sems rnam gnyis bsgom 'tshal lam mi 'tshal zhus pas/ byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis logs su bsgom mi dgos/ don dam byang chub kyi sems rang byung lhan cig skyes pa yin pas/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems mi dgos/ de la jo bo bka' gdams pa kun gyi zhal nas/ stong pa nyid bsgom sngas na (13na)kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems ma 'byongs par stong pa nyid du bsgoms pas nyan thos su gol nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam du mi 'gro gsung ste/ nyan thos la stong pa'i rnam grangs ma yin pa'i don dam pa med pas nyan thos su mi 'gro/ yang khong gi zhal nas/ sangs rgyas kyi nyan thos la stong pa rgya chen por gsungs pa yod de/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos kyi steng du gnas pas/ sprul pa'i nyan thos rnams la gsungs pa yin gyis/ nyan thos rang kha ma la stong pa rgya chen por gsungs pa med/ rnam grangs kyi stong pa don dam pa las mi rtogs/ des na don dam gyi steng na gnas pa'i dus su/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la sogs pa kun rdzob tsam byas pa'i chos yin pas dran yul dang dmigs yul du byar mi rung ste/ byas na slar yang 'ching ba yin pas/ yid la mi bya gsung*/ tshogs rnam pa gnyis rtag tu bsag 'tshal lam mi 'tshal zhus pas/ ngo bo rnyed pa'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i dus su/ lus ngag gi dge ba dang bsod nams kyi tshogs 'dus byas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bya mi dgos/ jo bo'i zhal nas/

spyir ni mnyam bzhag sems brtan na// lus ngag dge ba gtsor mi bya// zhes gsungs pa de yin/ glang po rnyed nas rjes mi btsal/ brtsas ma byas nas zhing mi bsrung*/ 'o na bsod nams kyi tshogs de gzugs sku gnyis kyi rgyu ma lags sam/ de bzhag pas cang mchi'am zhus pas/ gzugs sku gnyis thob par byed pa la sngar gyi tshogs bsags pa des chog /sngar ma bsags na byang chub kyi sems skyer mi btub/ (13ba) don dam skyes pa de'i sngon du bsod nams song bar gsal bas nges mchi gsung*/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis spel 'tshal lam mi 'tshal zhus pas/ ngo bo rgyun chags kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pas/ bskyed rdzogs rim gyis pa mi dgos pa yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang rnam smin sha khrag gi lus ma zad bar du/ bskyed rim lha'i rnal 'byor skad cig gis sgyu ma lta bur wal tsam re bsgom gsung*/ 'o na bar do'i chos logs su bsgom 'tshal lam mi 'tshal zhus pas/ ngo bo'i thog tu bsgom pa las bar do logs su bsgom mi dgos/ ngo bo dang bar do'i 'od gsal tha dad med pas/ da lta dang 'chi ka gnyis bar do logs su bsgom mi dgos gsung*/ 'o na da lta nas sangs rgyas pa'am/ ye nas sangs rgyas pa lags bkres skom na tsha la sogs pa 'ong ba tsug lags byas pas/ sems sangs rgyas yin yang na tsha dang grang dro bkres skom la sogs pas sdug bsngal 'ong ba de/ rang sems rnam smin gyi lus kyi gor chud pas len pa yin/ sangs rgyas lus kyi go rar tshud pa yin te/ dper na khyung sgo ngar tshud pa'am/ seng ge mngal rgyar chud pa dang 'dra gsung*/ tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas na da lta lam rtags mi gda' ba tsug lags zhus pas/ bar dor sangs rgya ba de btsan thabs su sangs rgyas pa yin/ lam ma bgrod par lam rtags mi 'ong gsung*/ ye shes rgyun chad dam ma chad zhus pas/ ye shes rgyun ma chad/ gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis la mkhyen pa gnyis dang ye shes lnga la sogs pa yod pas/

gzhan don de las (14na)'byung ba yin gsung*/ chos sku las gzugs sku 'char ba'i dpe don chos gzhung nas mang du bshad mod kyis/ 'on kyang sems kyi dbang du byas na/ da lta'i sems gsal la rtog pa med pa chos kyi sku de las sems sna tshogs su 'char ba de gzugs sku yin gsung*/ 'o na ngo bo bsgoms pa gcig pus 'ong lags sam zhus pas/ don hril gyis dril ba la ngo bo skyes pa'i rtogs ldan gyi gang zag des sems ma bcos pa'i ngang las chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du bsgom pa las/ gzhan gang la yang 'jug par mi bya gsung*/ rin po ches gsungs pa las ma phri ma bsnan pa zhus lan gnad kyi man ngag ces bya ba/ shākya'i bande rdor rgyal gyis zhus pa'o// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// chos rje sgam po pa la rnal 'byor chos g.yung gis ngo bo'i ga dar zhus pa'i zhus lan nas/ sngar byas pa'i sdig pa rnams stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags pa dang*/ ngo bo yud tsam zhig bsgoms pa gnyis 'dag 'ol gang che zhus pas/ de ngo bo yud tsam zhig bsgoms pa 'dag 'ol che gsung*/ 'jig rten blos btang nas ri khrod 'grim pa la lto gos dgos na/ ka ca bag re nya ra bya'am/ bcud len bya'am/ nor sgrub sla ba 'dra bya'am/ thams cad mi bya bar shi na yang shi/ bsgom lags sam zhus pas/ de la bla ma mi la'i zhal nas/ ka ca med na sprang ba'am gzhan la re na sgom mi 'ong gsung*/ rang gi 'tsho ba bag tsam nya ra bya gsungs te/ thams cad bzhag nas bsgoms pa rang gis chog /'tsho ba mkha' 'gro (14ba) thams cad kyis 'tsho ba sbyor ba yin/ bcud len ye ma byed grub pa med/ nad la phan pa'i don du cong zhi en tsam re ma gtogs gzhan mi bya/ nor sgrub sla ba 'dra bag tsam byas kyang 'gal ba med gsung*/ gnas grub pa thob pa'i gnas su bsgom mam/ ri stong brag stong du bsgom mam/ lung zhig zhu zhus pas/ gnas gar bder bsgom/ rang dga' na ri lung med/

mi bde ba byung na yun thung du bsgom gsung*/ lus ngag gi dge sbyor byed snying mi 'dod na/ ngo bo gcig pu bsgoms na tsug mchi zhus pas/ bla ma mi la'i zhal nas/ lus ngag gi dge ba mi bya dgos snyam na dgos bdo ba yin/ dgos snyam pa dang mi dgos snyam pa dang bral na ma dgos pa yin gsung*/ gzhan don rgyud bcad nas bsgoms na zhus pas/ bsam pas sems can ma spangs pas gzhan snang la gzugs sku rnam gnyis 'grub/ sbyor bas spangs pas chog gsung*/ ngo bo'i nang du skyabs su 'gro na chos nyid thob pa'i skyabs 'gro/ sdom pa na zag med/ snying rje na dmigs med/ sems bskyed na don dam/ dam tshig na ye bsrungs chen po yar ldan yin/ gdams ngag gcig tu bsdus nas bsgom gsung*/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa dang ngo bo'i khyad par ci lags/ gzhan ma tsho mi dgos sam zhus pas/ gzhan ma tsho byas kyang brdzun byed pa yin/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi rang bzhin ngo bo yin/ ma rig pa dang lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gnyis lag pa'i lto rgyab dang 'dra/ ma rtogs kyi bar du ma rig pa 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin/ rtogs pa dang ye shes dang sangs rgyas kyi rtsa ba yin gsung*/ ngo bo rtse gcig tu ye re ba dang*/ (15na)rig pa gyu gyu ba gnyis gang yin zhus pas/ de gnyis ka yin/ sems can thams cad la ngo bo 'di yin 'di min bya ba med/ snang ba thams cad sems/ sems thams cad rig pa/ rig pa thams cad ngo bo yin gsung*/ ngo bo bsgom pa la spyod lam ci tsug bsgom/ mig btsums pa dang ma btsums pa gnyis gang lags zhus pas/ spyod lam rnam bzhi gang byed kyang bsgoms pas chog /spyod lam la nges pa med/ mig btsums pa dang ma btsums pa 'dra/ dang po ma btsum pas bde ba/ 'byongs tsa na btsum pa bde ba gsung*/ nga bdag 'dzin blos btang zin/ tshe gzhug 'di la ri khrod 'grim ngo bo bsgom pa yin/ de la 'di dgos bya ba'i gdams ngag yod na zhu/

rgya la gnyan sar bsgoms pa'am/ lung stong dang ri stong du 'dre rgod dang 'phrad pa'am/ bdud rigs dang yi dwags kyis bar chad byung na/ ci ltar bgyi zhus pas/ ri khrod du lta ba'i gdengs/ bsgom pa'i gdengs/ yi dam lha'i snying po'i gdengs gsum dang ldan par bya/ de las ci yang med na/ gnyan sar 'dre rgod kyis bar chad rtsom pa byung na/ gnod pa de gang na gnas pa la gtor ma byin la/ gnod pa ma byed bya/ chos skyong la gtor ma byin/ bla ma dang dkon mchog dang mkha' 'gro la gsol ba gdab/ snying po mang du bzlas pas bar chad mi 'ong*/ sangs rgyas dang 'o skol gyi bar na grub thob mi bzhi las med/ de rnams kyi mkha' 'gro ma thams cad sgom pa'i phyi na phar la khyi bzhin du 'gro zhing 'dug pas/ slob ma sgom pa can la bar chad byung ba med gsung*/ lha 'dre'i gnod pa byung na ngo bo bsgom pa dang*/ (15ba) stong pa stong nyams can bsgom pa gang dga' zhus pas/ ngo bo'i sgom kho na bsgom pa'i steng du lha rnams kyang mi 'gro ba yin pas/ 'dre gdon la sogs pas mi tshugs la/ stong pa ni lha 'dres kyang bsgom shes/ sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed shes/ ngo bo rtogs ma myong bas/ ngo bo mi shes pas bsgom mi shes te/ ngo bo lha 'dre'i yul du ma gyur pas/ ngo bo rang bsgom pa kho na dga' gsung ngo*// ngo bo bsgoms pa la nyams myong 'ong ngam mi 'ong zhus pas/ 'ong ste nyams myong gis nga rgyal chags pa yin/ 'jig rten gyi zhen pa lings la thongs nas 'ong ba yin/ chos gzhan thams cad la dgos pa med par phyi shun du 'gro ba yin/ rang la yid ches shing blo bde lhan gyis 'gro ba yin/ ngo bo skyes pa'i nyams rtogs de tsho 'ong ba yin gsung*/ mkhyen pa gnyis dang ye shes lnga po sangs rgyas pa'i dus na ji ltar mnga' zhus pas/ de tsho'i bshad pa thams cad blos byas pa'i yon tan yin/ 'o skol gyis kyang blos byas nas 'bru mnan na/

chos sku dang gzugs sku gnyis ka la sbyar du btub ste/ don la sangs rgyas bya ba blo las 'das pa yin gzugs sku gnyis gzhan khong rang blos byas pa'i ngor yon tan de tsho snang gsung*/ gtso bor tsog pur byas nas phyag rgya ma byas par rlung bsgoms na 'ong ngam mi 'ong zhus pas/ de yang 'ong ba 'ong ste/ sman dpyad kun nas dus rtag tu tsog pur bsdad na/ rgyu ma rul nas 'gro bar bshad/ skyil mo krung la yon tan mang po yod par bshad pas/ de dga' ba yin gsung*/ ngo bo rtogs zer yang mi dge ba la 'jug cing*/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems chung bar 'dug na/ ngo bo ma skyes pa yin bya ba bla ma mi las gsung (16na)pas de ltar yin gsung*// ༈ //gu ru na mo/ phag mo gru pas/ bla ma mang po la gtugs pa'i mthar gyis chos thams cad nyams su blangs nas/ phyis rje sgam po pa dang gleng slong byas pas/ khyed kyi de yang rtog pa yin/ de yang rtog bcas yin bya ba lan mang du gsung skad/ 'o na phyag rgya chen po de ji lta bu zhig lags shes zhus pas/ khams ston yang dag par na chos phyag rgya chen po de 'di yin gsungs nas/ phyi rnam par rtog pa'i yul la mi 'phro ba/ nang shes pa bying rmug tu ma song ba/ rig pa'i go ma 'gags pa/ ngo bo nyid kyi rig stong rtsa bral du dwangs sing ba rtogs pa 'di gsungs pas/ bla ma phag mo gru pas chos 'di yin bya ba'am/ 'di min bya ba'i brda thams cad dang bral ba zhig tu rtogs pas langs ma nus pa la/ bla ma'i zhal nas langs nas 'ong gsung*/ de gong gi bla ma kun ci red na bya ba lan 'ga' gsung skad/ rje'i zhal nas phyag rgya chen po blo las 'das pa bya ba yang de rang yin no// smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// bya ba de ka yin/ tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad// bya ba de ka yin/ mthar thug gi don la dmigs gtad med bya ba'ang de yin/ rig pa'i ngo bo sgom du song nas dran pa la blo gtad mi dgos par 'dug

/sgom bya ba phar blos gtad bsgom mi dgos par gda'/ sgom kho rang gis tshur skul nas 'ong bar 'dug skad/ bla ma phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ nam mkha' la mtha' dbus med/ ber ka la mgo mjug med/ lham sgrog bcings nas skyas gzhug rdzogs/ blo 'das kyi rnal 'byor pa de nga la 'ong bar 'dug /blo la lhag ma med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa (16ba) la zer bar 'dug /sems nyid la rang byan tshud tsa na gzhan don yong ba yin par 'dug /da nga khams su 'gro don mi 'dug gsung skad// ༈ //bla ma rje btsun dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe la long med myur du 'chi bas/ 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad la ma chags pa zhig dgos/ 'gro ba rigs drug gar skyes skyid med cing*/ sdug bsngal gyi phung por shes pas/ 'khor ba mtha' dag la ma chags pa zhig dgos/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba snying rje yin pas/ dus thams cad du sems can blos mi gtong ba zhig dgos/ chos thams cad ma skyes shing skye ba med par shes pas/ gang la yang dngos po dang mtshan mar mi 'dzin pa zhig dgos gsung*/ de rnams rgyud la skye ba la bla ma dang*/ jo bo dkon mchog gsum la dad pa dang gus pa'i sgo nas mchod pa dang*/ gsol ba 'debs pa rgyun ma chad par byed dgos gsungs pas na/ de yang rang la yod pa rang gis myong bar bya dgos pa dang*/ rang la yod par rang gis rtogs par bya dgos pa dang*/ rang la yod pa rang gis thob par bya dgos/ de'i ngo bo ni sems ma bcos pa gnyug ma'i don yin te/ rang byung ma bcos pa de la nges pa thob nas/ de yang so mar gzhag /rten mi bca' bar gzhag /rang dgar gzhag /lhug par gzhag /blang dor med par gzhag /dmigs gtad med par mi bca' bar gzhag /sing nge gzhag /lhang nge lhan ne gzhag /bcas bcos mi bya bar rang shugs su gzhag go /thabs ni skyil krung legs par bca'// mig sna rtser legs par dbab/ lce rkan la sbyar/

mgrin pa en tsam dgug ste/ shes pa snga ma ni 'das/ (17na)phyi ma ni ma skyes/ da lta ba la ngos bzung med par bya/ de yang sems dang sems las byung ba gnyis/ phra ba dang rags pa'o// phra ba ni dge mi dge lung du ma bstan pa'o// sems ni rig pa ma bcos pa de yin/ de dang po gang nas byung*/ ngo bo cir 'dug /tha mar gar 'gag ltos dang*/ dang po gang nas kyang 'ong ba med/ bar du dbyibs dang kha dog tu grub pa med/ tha ma gang du yang 'gag pa med pas/ de ltar yang dang yang du bsgom mo// de ltar bsgoms pas snang ba sems su 'char/ sems nyid sangs rgyas su 'char gsung*/ snang ba sems su shes pas gnyis snang du ma song*/ sems nyid rig par shes pas bem por ma song*/ rig pa stong par shes pas mtshan mar ma song*/ stong pa bde bar shes pas sdug bsngal du ma song*/ bde ba rang sems yin pas gzhan snang du ma song*/ sems la ngos bzung med pas dmigs pa dang ma dmigs pa med pas phyag rgya chen po yin/ rje btsun gyi gsung lan no// rje phag mo gru pa'i zhus lan rdzogs so// //
